items.text: Boat power‑down now works reliably when lowering sails and jumping off, preventing unintended drifting.
Helipad stages have been fixed, restoring proper functionality of the airwolf landing pad.
Oil rig pumps now have a 15‑minute start delay, extending the total pump cycle to 20 minutes plus any configured delay.
Building on terrain deformation now respects a configurable tolerance, reducing placement errors on uneven ground.
Large‑scale map structures now render correctly after an HLOD fix, preventing missing buildings in the North Sea map.
Squirrels have had their movement speed adjusted, affecting how quickly they traverse the map.
Computer station identifier input now displays text correctly at all resolutions.
Biofuel generator UI now includes a progress bar, making fuel production timing clearer.
Store UI now caches throttled image requests correctly, preventing missing icons when quickly switching tabs.
Sprint is now correctly disabled during attacks across the network, preventing unintended sprinting while firing.
Fixed a bug that prevented adding devices to computer stations, restoring full functionality for base building.

2026-09-21.summary:
### Vehicles
- Boat power‑down now works reliably when lowering sails and jumping off, preventing unintended drifting.
- Helipad stages have been fixed, restoring proper functionality of the airwolf landing pad.

### Monuments & World
- Oil rig pumps now have a 15‑minute start delay, extending the total pump cycle to 20 minutes plus any configured delay.
- Building on terrain deformation now respects a configurable tolerance, reducing placement errors on uneven ground.
- Large‑scale map structures now render correctly after an HLOD fix, preventing missing buildings in the North Sea map.

### Animals
- Squirrels have had their movement speed adjusted, affecting how quickly they traverse the map.

### Base & UI
- Computer station identifier input now displays text correctly at all resolutions.
- Biofuel generator UI now includes a progress bar, making fuel production timing clearer.
- Store UI now caches throttled image requests correctly, preventing missing icons when quickly switching tabs.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sprint is now correctly disabled during attacks across the network, preventing unintended sprinting while firing.
- Fixed a bug that prevented adding devices to computer stations, restoring full functionality for base building.

items.text: Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.
Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

2026-09-20.summary:
### Base Building
- Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

### Livestock & Animals
- Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

### Item Durability
- Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

items.text: Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.
Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.

2026-09-19.summary:
### Livestock & Animal Behavior
- Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
- Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
- Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
- Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
- Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

### UI & Store
- Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.
